brief: Paste the notes, logs and chat messages from the incident.
name: Incident postmortem
description: A timeline and the causes worked out at the same time, actions that prevent a repeat, a blameless review, then the write-up.

steps.prompt:
From these notes, logs and messages, write the timeline of the incident in UTC, one line per event, from the first sign to full recovery:
{{brief}}

From the same material, find the causes: what set it off, why it was not caught earlier, and what made it last longer. Ask why five times. Blame no person; name systems and decisions.
{{brief}}
Is it blameless? Is every action specific and checkable? Is there an action that the causes do not explain?
